svg.aria-label: Bursar architecture: agents propose through a tool layer, the decision pipeline and policy engine decide, approvals and the executor act on PayPal, and the verifier confirms every movement of money.
svg.title: Bursar architecture
svg.text: Sandbox money only. An agent proposes, a policy decides, an executor acts, and PayPal confirms.
